g.text: course_code : text / UK with code and term
results_published_at : timestamptz / NULL until assignment-wide publication
submission_id : uuid «FK,UK» / NULL when no submission
graded_version_number : integer «FK» / NULL when no submission
token_hash : text «PK» / SHA256; never raw token
16 business tables + 2 authentication tables; schema_migrations omitted.
grades: UNIQUE(assignment_id, enrollment_id); submission/version may both be NULL.
classes: UNIQUE(course_code, code, term). grade_history: append-only snapshots.
AUTO_ZERO_NO_SUBMISSION: score 0, Published, no fake submission.
PK = primary key; FK = foreign key; UK = unique.
